Scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
Scapegoat.text: Play the Circus Ex Mortis campaign as Jenny Barnes and defeat Sacrificial Beast at a location with a copy of Terrified Captives attached.

MoonlightSonata.name: Moonlight Sonata
MoonlightSonata.text: Play the Circus Ex Mortis campaign as Jim Culver and reveal three or more moon tokens while resolving Final Rhapsody.

GravesideChat.name: Graveside Chat
GravesideChat.text: Play the Circus Ex Mortis campaign as Marie Lambeau and have Baron Samedi and Lady Esprit in play at the same time.

WolfOfWallStreet.name: Wolf of Wall Street
WolfOfWallStreet.text: Play the Circus Ex Mortis campaign and have Monstrous Transformation and Lone Wolf in play at the same time while you control 20 or more resources.

DestinedKarma.name: Destined Karma
DestinedKarma.text: Get +3 skill value from the ability on Amalthea Weaver during a skill test that defeats The Black Goat.

TimeOut.name: Time Out!
TimeOut.text: Activate the action ability on De Cultus Bestiae while you are engaged with 3 or more enemies.

WaxAndWane.name: Wax and Wane
WaxAndWane.text: Cancel 1 moon token and release 2 moon tokens during a single skill test using Invocation of Diana.

ShootTheMoon.name: Shoot the Moon
ShootTheMoon.text: Reveal four or more moon tokens during a single skill test.

UtterLunatic.name: Utter Lunatic
UtterLunatic.text: Release all six moon tokens from your investigator card at the end of a single round.

ClownCollege.name: Clown College
ClownCollege.text: Evade a New Moon Clown using Disguise.

NaturalSelection.name: Natural Selection
NaturalSelection.text: Defeat a New Moon Beast Tamer via an ability on a Creature asset you control.

LactoseIntolerant.name: Lactose Intolerant
LactoseIntolerant.text: Cancel two or more copies of Milk of Shub-Niggurath during a single scenario.

DeepSleepers.name: Deep Sleepers
DeepSleepers.text: Reach Resolution 2 of Harm's Way without any investigator being attacked by a Towering Dark Young.

PainTrain.name: Pain Train
PainTrain.text: Earn 3 or more trauma during All Points West.

ViceSquad.name: Vice Squad
ViceSquad.text: Reach Resolution 2 of Bacchanalia with each investigator choosing all four vices.

ManyFutures.name: Many Futures
ManyFutures.text: Obtain each final version of Amalthea Weaver.

ManyPasts.name: Many Pasts
ManyPasts.text: Obtain each final version of De Cultus Bestiae.

GOAT.name: G.O.A.T.
GOAT.text: Place 8 or more damage per investigator on Shub-Niggurath in a single round.

StealTheShow.name: Steal the Show
StealTheShow.text: Win the Circus Ex Mortis campaign with only Performer investigators chosen for the campaign.

GreatestShowOnEarth.name: Greatest Show on Earth
GreatestShowOnEarth.text: Win the Circus Ex Mortis campaign on Expert difficulty.
